_about: One entry per sprite in ghdathegabbalion/Aster/sprites/. Each is regenerated img2img off its current file so pose, composition and setting survive while the design moves to canon. 'scene' is appended after characters/aster-prompt.txt. 'fix' names drift seen in the current file, so the checker knows what to look at first. Tune 'denoise' here, not in regen.py.

full.name: idle
full.scene: full body, standing, hands clasped in front, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf, sunset beach, calm sea, constellation line-art in the sky
full.fix: sweater is white-blue (lock: lavender); tail has no cream fur base; no pouch; no bloom; brown eyes; plain cream paws

full.name: wave
full.scene: full body, waving with one hand, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf, beach at sunset, waves
full.fix: the style reference — change as little as possible; no bloom; brown eyes; coral tail transition; plain cream paws

full.name: happy
full.scene: full body, jumping, laughing with open mouth, white t-shirt with violet star print, navy shorts, splashing in the ocean, bright blue sky, white clouds
full.fix: TWO TAILS (cream fox tail plus separate tentacle) — the worst sprite; no scarf; no pouch. Expect to need the 0.55 pass or an inpaint on the tail

full.name: dance
full.scene: full body, dancing, arms raised, eyes closed, smiling, white sundress, straw sun hat, lavender neckerchief, desert dunes at sunset
full.fix: tail is all tentacle with no cream fur base or marigold band; no pouch; no bloom (hat may hide the ear base: bloom on the hat band is acceptable)

full.name: think
full.scene: sitting in a plum velvet armchair, reading a book, round reading glasses, lavender turtleneck sweater, cosy night library, bookshelves
full.fix: no scarf; no pouch; no bloom; tail base hidden by the chair — the marigold band must still show where the tail emerges

full.name: sleepy
full.scene: upper body, yawning, holding a mug of cocoa with whipped cream, oversized lavender sweater, messy blonde bob, bedroom, morning window light, star-patterned bedding
full.fix: hair merges into head fur; tail barely visible; no pouch, bloom or ink paws. Pouch on a bedroom sprite is canon now (every outfit)

full.name: excited
full.scene: full body, jumping with joy, glowing violet magic circles, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf, rocky beach at sunset, constellations
full.fix: the only sprite that already has ink paws — keep them; cream tail and tentacle read as two limbs; no bloom; no pouch

full.name: shy
full.scene: full body, bashful, holding sweater hem, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf, standing in shallow sea at sunset
full.fix: cream constellation tail and tentacle read as two limbs; no pouch; no bloom; brown eyes

chibi._about: Desktop-pet cutouts. Rendered on a flat mint background so cutout.ps1 can key it out — mint is far from cream fur, lavender and ink-violet, so the flood fill stops cleanly at her edge. The source cutout is composited onto that mint inside the graph, because a transparent PNG fed straight to img2img comes out on black.
chibi.background: (plain flat mint green background:1.3), simple background, no scenery
chibi.prefix: chibi, super deformed, big head, stubby limbs, full body, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf
